title: Automations mod.json
description: What Herdr reads from the Automations mod's mod.json, and the settings it takes. The Automations themselves live in ~/.config/herdr-app/data/automation/automations.json.

title.description: The mod's name, as Herdr shows it.

place.description: Where Herdr first docks the mod. "none": only where a layout or another mod puts it.

focusable.description: Lets pane.go give a shown copy the keyboard.

settings.description: Your changes. A setting left out uses its default.

agent.title: Default agent
agent.description: The agent of a new Automation: a program key from Herdr's known agents, such as claude or codex.

space.title: Space
space.description: The space that holds the Runs' tabs. It is made when missing.

worktreeRetention.title: Worktree retention
worktreeRetention.description: How long a Run's worktree is kept before a clean one is removed, such as "7d" or "12h".

historyRetention.title: History retention
historyRetention.description: How long history days and run folders are kept, such as "30d".

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Which Runs post a toast: failures (failed, timed out, blocked), failures and skips (also skipped and missed), all, or never.

gitPollInterval.title: Git poll interval
gitPollInterval.description: How often a remote git Trigger reads its branch, such as "5m".

agentTimeout.title: Agent timeout
agentTimeout.description: The timeout of an agent Automation that sets none, such as "60m".

scriptTimeout.title: Script timeout
scriptTimeout.description: The timeout of a script Automation that sets none, such as "10m".
